A [[Human/Legends|Human]] at some point served as an '''officer''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that they wore long and braided. The [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a dark-colored [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|uniform]] with a [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaque]] with four blue squares. Their uniform also included a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and a cap with an [[Officer's disk/Legends|officer's disk]].<ref name="Balance" />

At some point, a pair of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] brought a captured Human before the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. Looking down into the face of the [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] captive with a faint smile, the officer then motioned behind them with their left [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="Balance" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial officer was depicted on a card in<ref name="Balance" /> the [[December 13]], [[2013]]<ref name="Unleash">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2013/12/13/unleash-the-power-of-the-force|text=Unleash the Power of the Force}}</ref> ''[[Balance of the Force]]'' expansion of [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Card Game]]''. The officer was illustrated by [[Cristi Balanescu]].<ref name="Balance" />
